records.context: S1 failing collapses prometaphase and metaphase, S2 ana_telo_cyto and telophase_daughters together (it judges their 2N pairs jointly), S3 (which judges every stage) each model stage one level; S1 and S2 both failing with S4 passing collapse to ``mitotic`` only, and S4 failing too collapses ``mitotic`` to ``G2/M``. records.source: S1 failing collapses prometaphase and metaphase, S2 ana_telo_cyto and telophase_daughters together (it judges their 2N pairs jointly), S3 (which judges every stage) each model stage one level; S1 and S2 both failing with S4 passing collapse to ``mitotic`` only, and S4 failing too collapses ``mitotic`` to ``G2/M``. A skipped check collapses nothing.
records.translation: S1 失败时合并 prometaphase 和 metaphase，S2 失败时同时合并 ana_telo_cyto 和 telophase_daughters（共同评估这两类的 2N 细胞对），S3（检查每个阶段）失败时将各模型阶段上移一级；S1 和 S2 均失败但 S4 通过时，只合并到 ``mitotic``，若 S4 也失败，则将 ``mitotic`` 合并到 ``G2/M``。S5 失败时合并 prometaphase 和 metaphase。S6 的 R² 检查失败时合并 G1、S 和 G2；若只有 G2/G1 比值检查失败，则将 S 和 G2 合并为 ``S/G2``（记录为失败阶段 ``'S/G2'``）。跳过的检查不会触发任何合并。
